main.description: Replace the roles granted read and write in a space, written into its org.atgrp.policy. Requires service-auth. Requires the `space.configure` action.

space.description: URI of the space to update.

roles.description: Record keys of the org.atgrp.role records granted read and write in the space, written into its org.atgrp.policy.

errors.name: InvalidSpace
errors.description: The provided space URI is not a valid open social space.
